Return markdown text with hanging indent

Source: R/formatting.R
hanging_indent.Rd

Return markdown text with hanging indent

Usage

hanging_indent(
  x,
  indent = 4,
  width = 30,
  space = NULL,
  newline = "\\\\\n",
  whitespace_only = FALSE,
  wrap_equal_width = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

text

indent

number of space characters that indent the second and later lines

width

maximum number of characters per line

space

indenting character. If NULL (default), a non-breaking space.

newline

text inserted at each line break (default: a markdown hard line break, a backslash followed by a newline)

whitespace_only

if TRUE, lines break only at spaces. If FALSE (default), they can also break after hyphens and slashes (see stringr::str_wrap()).

wrap_equal_width

if TRUE, lines are made roughly equal in width (see str_wrap_equal()). If FALSE (default), each line is filled up to width.

Value

character vector

Examples

hanging_indent(
  "Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical power analysis for the behavioral sciences (2nd ed.). Erlbaum."
)
#> [1] "Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical\\\n    power analysis for the\\\n    behavioral sciences (2nd ed.).\\\n    Erlbaum."
